excerpt: Compare Al Marjan Island and Mina Al Arab investments using the exact unit, rental strategy, ownership right, costs and delivery risk.
introduction:
Al Marjan Island and Mina Al Arab are distinct Ras Al Khaimah waterfront settings. The stronger investment depends on the specific building, purchase cost, permitted rental use, tenant demand and future competition. Assess each apartment’s price, rental evidence and running costs alongside its waterfront setting.

This comparison uses developer descriptions and a sample yield example. Verify the current project and unit before relying on any figures.
takeaways: Compare actual homes, views, access and building charges, not only the master community.
Verify the buyer's right, project status and permitted rental strategy with the relevant authorities.
Use comparable leases and full acquisition cost; test vacancy, repairs and eventual sale.

sections.heading: How do the settings differ?
sections.body:
[Marjan's Al Marjan Island page](https://marjan.ae/development/masterplans/al-marjan-island) describes a waterfront master development with an expanding residential offering. [RAK Properties' Mina page](https://mina.rakproperties.ae/) describes coastal residential communities with apartments, villas and resorts. These are developer sources; confirm the actual phase and facilities for the unit.

Visit the building or site, inspect the view and route to the waterfront, and check parking and daily services. A masterplan image does not guarantee a view, beach access or completed amenity for every apartment. Ask about nearby construction and scheduled handovers.

The [RAK lifestyle guide](/journal/ras-al-khaimah-property-lifestyle) provides wider location context; the unit's own documents and condition determine the decision.

sections.heading: Compare net income and capital
sections.body:
Suppose a sample Al Marjan unit requires AED 1,200,000 in total acquisition cost and produces AED 60,000 net operating income after vacancy and owner costs, or 5%. A sample Mina Al Arab unit costs AED 1,000,000 and produces AED 48,000 net, or 4.8%. These example inputs show how purchase costs and annual income affect the two calculations.

The chart compares the assumed yields before finance, tax and sale costs. The first example needs AED 200,000 more capital and produces AED 12,000 more annual income under these assumptions. Change the inputs using actual leases, fees and building costs.

Test a longer vacancy, higher service charge and an unexpected repair. The [RAK 2027 outlook](/journal/ras-al-khaimah-property-investment-outlook) provides aggregate context, not a yield for either unit.

sections.heading: Check ownership and transaction costs
sections.body:
RAK Municipality's [sale registration service](https://sanad.mun.rak.ae/docs/en/services-card-arabic-temp-28) lists both Al Marjan Island and Mina Al Arab among designated freehold areas. Confirm the current right for your nationality and exact unit, and request an itemised transaction quote.

Review title or initial registration, seller authority, any mortgage or tenancy, service-charge statement and developer clearance. For off-plan, verify the registered project, payment recipient, contract, instalments and handover provisions. Keep receipts and the official registration outcome.

Add buyer-paid registration, brokerage, finance, initial work and furnishing to the price. A lower advertised price is not the complete acquisition cost.

sections.heading: Choose and verify a rental strategy
sections.body:
For a long-term lease, use recent signed leases for similar apartments and deduct vacancy, service charges, management, repairs and insurance. Record the date, furnishing, parking and view. Compare asking rents with signed leases and the income collected from similar homes.

For short stays, confirm the current RAK Tourism Development Authority permit, operator and building requirements before assuming that use is allowed. Its [holiday-home system update](https://raktda.com/press-release-ras-al-khaimah-tourism-development-authority-continues-to-diversify-tourism-offering-with-new-updates-to-its-rak-holiday-homes-system/) describes registration by owners and operators. Include cleaning, utilities, platform and management costs and seasonal empty nights.

A tourism arrival count or a planned resort opening cannot be converted directly into occupancy for one apartment.

[ARN also reported the authority’s holiday-home registration update](https://www.arnnewscentre.ae/en/news/uae/ras-al-khaimah-simplifies-holiday-homes-system/). Verify current requirements directly with the authority.

sections.heading: Assess supply, timing and the exit
sections.body:
Review nearby ready homes and scheduled projects that may compete for similar tenants. A handover date is a plan and can change. Ask for dated construction evidence and read the contract's delay and default provisions. Keep funds for instalments even if rental income begins later than expected.

Seek recent completed sales of genuinely similar units where available and distinguish them from asking prices. Include selling expenses and any remaining loan. A view or brand may affect the comparison, but a future premium needs evidence and is not guaranteed.

Inspect maintenance and insurance arrangements for the specific coastal building. Seek a qualified assessment if you identify a technical issue.

sections.heading: Compare the owner's workload
sections.body:
Ask who will market the property, handle guests or tenants, collect payments and arrange repairs. Obtain a written management quote and check the fee base, reporting and approval limits. A holiday-home strategy can involve more frequent cleaning and guest support than an annual lease.

Set a holding period and cash reserve for both options. A property that only works under full occupancy or a guaranteed capital gain needs a more conservative plan.

sections.heading: Run a like-for-like viewing
sections.body:
Create one viewing sheet for each candidate. Record internal area, balcony size, floor, direction, parking, furniture and the distance from the entrance to the beach or pool. Photograph the actual outlook where permitted, and note nearby construction from the apartment rather than relying on a map.

Ask the manager for a year of service-charge statements and any planned works, then make the same assumptions for vacancy and repairs in both calculations. If one apartment has a tenant, review the lease, deposit and notice arrangements before estimating when you can use or re-let it. A larger unit or an included amenity may explain a price difference, so do not compare the advertised price alone.

If reliable lease evidence is unavailable, use a range of assumptions and mark the result as uncertain. An independent inspection or valuation can help where the purchase decision depends on condition or a precise market value.

sections.heading: Request current units
sections.body:
Browse [Aliyas Al Marjan Island projects](/projects?emirate=Ras%20Al%20Khaimah&area=rak-al-marjan-island) and the [RAK project collection](/projects?emirate=Ras%20Al%20Khaimah) for Mina Al Arab options. [Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget and intended use.

Ask which exact units are currently available and verify their rights, charges and terms before committing.
